title: Generalize Method A: Pandey–Kumar Mode-I Figures 5(b) and 6(a) Reproduction and Reusable Indicator-Driven Remeshing Transfer
objective: Reproduce Pandey and Kumar (2025) Section 4.1 Figures 5(b) and 6(a) on the 1x1 mm Mode-I benchmark; demonstrate indicator-driven adaptive remeshing transfer from Section 4.3 without prescribing the future crack path; compare quantitatively against published results.
